coverage_notes.search_quality: DEGRADED: Twelve searches returned largely stale background articles, future/proposed events, Canadian/international results, and unrelated stories despite two-day recency filtering. No reliable new local/official event evidence surfaced, with particularly weak territorial and rural recall.
coverage_notes.limitations: No findings is not evidence that no access changes occurred. Search result relevance and rural/territorial reporting are non-exhaustive; production collection is authoritative. No current-hour confirmations found for older announced transitions.
coverage_notes.controls: Exactly one append-only private heartbeat on ops/watch-ledger; no editorial review approvals, public publication, schedule change or disabling.
